race.comment: The penny has dropped for the well-related PRECISE STAR (1) (half to G2 winner Mokulua) who has strung back-to-back wins together this campaign and is racing with a lot of confidence since joining the Gollan yard. Gets a bunch of weight off with the 3kg claim and looks the one they all have to run down. WOUNDER (7) returned to the winners' stall over this mile journey at the latest outing and winning rider Lang stays on top. Looms as the main danger. GAGNANTE ENCHERE (10) will be cherry-ripe fit for this and gets Thompson on board from the low draw. Top-three candidate. POSSIBILITIES (2) is an honest commodity who is yet to miss a drum in five starts over this trip. Has to be included. PIERTAGA (12) next in line in a race with only a handful of chances.
